blocks.x: Connected Products & Smart Devices as delivered by Dataq Software: scope, delivery pattern, the platforms involved and the outcomes we commit to at each gate.

Connected products turn equipment vendors into service businesses — but only with fleet-grade engineering: secure provisioning and identity per device, OTA update infrastructure with staged rollout and rollback, telemetry pipelines into your data platform, and the product layer — usage analytics, predictive service, customer portals, usage-based billing. We build the device-to-revenue stack with security designed in: hardware roots of trust, signed firmware, vulnerability-management SLAs and disclosure processes aligned to cyber-resilience regulation (EU Cyber Resilience Act).

The commercial side is engineered with the technical: service-product design (uptime guarantees, consumables models, outcome contracts), pricing instrumentation from telemetry, and CRM/ERP integration so a sensor reading becomes a service ticket or a billing line. Clients launch connected service lines with real margin instead of free telematics portals that only cost money.

Programs run on a fixed rhythm so progress is visible from week one. Weeks 1–2 lock the baseline: the current metric is measured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses its gate is stopped or redirected with a documented decision, not quietly extended.
